name: open
expression: new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const check=()=>{if(document.querySelector('textarea')){o.disconnect();clearTimeout(t);resolve(true);return}const b=document.querySelector('.live-assistant-launcher');if(b)b.click();};const o=new MutationObserver(check);o.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,childList:true});const t=setTimeout(()=>{o.disconnect();reject(Error('Assistant did not hydrate'))},45000);check()})
